lines.say: 92.3k stars, for an AI workspace that you host yourself.
It's called Odysseus. One self-hosted app for chat, agents, research, documents, email, notes and your calendar.
It runs your local model workflows, and it also works with models you call through an API.
The agents get real tools to work with: MCP, files, a shell, skills, and memory.
The compose files pull the official multi-arch image, published on GitHub's container registry.
To start, clone the repo and copy the example env file into place.
Then run docker compose up, and wait until the containers are healthy.
Open localhost on port 7011, and your workspace is ready.
For production, pin the immutable 1.0.2 tag instead of latest.
It comes with powerful local tools, so keep AUTH_ENABLED set to true on any network-accessible deployment.
It already has 1.4k forks, and it's licensed under AGPL 3.0.
Save this for the day you move your AI tools onto your own hardware.
Odysseus. Your whole AI workspace, on your own server.
